questions.prompt: Which structure was completed across Panama in 1914?
questions.fact: An earlier French attempt collapsed after around 20,000 workers died, mostly of yellow fever and malaria.

questions.prompt: Which physical property does a hydrometer measure?
questions.fact: Brewers use one to track fermentation, since sugar turning to alcohol lowers the liquid's density.

questions.prompt: Which trophy is awarded to the winner of the NBA Finals?
questions.fact: It is made fresh each year, so winning teams keep theirs permanently.

questions.prompt: Which artist recorded the album Nevermind's rival, Ten?
questions.fact: The title refers to a basketball player's shirt number, not to any track on the record.

questions.prompt: Which country is the largest by area in Central America?
questions.fact: It contains the largest lake in the region, which is home to sharks that adapted to fresh water.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the play A Doll's House's contemporary, Hedda Gabler?
questions.fact: The title uses her maiden name deliberately, signalling that she has not accepted her marriage.

questions.prompt: Which technology allows a phone to unlock using facial geometry?
questions.fact: Projecting thousands of invisible dots is what stops a printed photograph from fooling it.
